claims.evidence: The witness report states the brand is null and was not read from the item.
Photo 0 shows the torch being held by a person, confirming its portable size.
Photo 1 shows a rear panel with a plug icon, indicating a charging port.
The witness did not see the light beam or confirm the bulb type.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch operating while unplugged for at least one minute.

risks.risk: The torch may not function at all.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch being switched on and off.

risks.risk: The charging cable may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the torch with its corresponding charging cable.

proof_requests: Video of the torch being switched on and off while unplugged.
Photo of any labels showing the model number and battery capacity.
Photo of the charging cable included with the sale.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a rechargeable torch. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a generic, non-functional unit until further proof is provided.
